title: This Ant Holds the Guinness Record for Most Dangerous
subject: bulldog ant

scenes.text: One ant holds the Guinness record for most dangerous.
It's the bulldog ant of Australia, and workers are only about two centimeters long.
It has excellent eyesight, and it can track intruders by sight from a distance.
It grips with toothed jaws, curls under, and drives in its stinger. Again and again.
On a few occasions, the sting has killed adults within fifteen minutes.
At least three people have died since 1936. The last was a farmer in 1988.

description:
Guinness lists the bulldog ant of Australia as the most dangerous ant.
It has excellent eyesight and stings repeatedly, and at least three people have died from stings since 1936.
Would you stay near a nest?
first_comment: Would you rather meet a bulldog ant or a bear? Be honest.
